extension.name: SMTP Router (IPIK)
extension.description: Route CiviCRM outbound emails to the correct SMTP server based on the From address, for hosting where each sender must authenticate individually.
extension.comments: Tested on CiviCRM 6.15.4 / WordPress / Infomaniak shared hosting. Uses PEAR Mail (Mail_smtp / Net_SMTP), not PHPMailer, for SMTP delivery, since that is the mail stack bundled on this CiviCRM install. A working sender address also requires matching entries under Administer -> Communications -> Mail Accounts and Administer -> Communications -> From Email Addresses. Developed with the assistance of Claude.ai (Anthropic).
